summary: Tested Desktop App settings feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/9 pytest pass (GET defaults, 401/403 auth, 400 validation for empty version / non-http url, save+persist, notify=false creates none, notify=true creates exactly one broadcast notif with user_id null, category 'update', cta_link '/profile?tab=desktop', visible to regular TEST_ user). One failure: size cannot be cleared (falls back to '99 MB'). Frontend: Admin > Platformă card prefilled, save shows toast, invalid url shows error toast, toggle works; /profile?tab=desktop opens tab directly with updated version text and download href = saved url; bell notification shows with 'Descarcă acum' CTA navigating to /profile?tab=desktop and opening the tab when coming from another page. BUG: CTA clicked while already on /profile changes URL but tab does NOT switch.

minor.issue: Uses `s.get(k) or v`, so saving size='' (field is optional) still returns default '99 MB'. Admin cannot clear size. Use `s.get(k, v)` when the key exists (only fall back if the doc/key is missing).
No dedup on notify=true: saving twice with same version broadcasts duplicate notifications to ALL users. Consider only notifying when version changed.

ui_bugs.issue: Tabs use uncontrolled defaultValue read from window.location.search on mount only. When user is already on /profile and clicks the notification CTA (navigate('/profile?tab=desktop')), URL changes but tab stays on previous tab (verified: tab-desktop data-state=inactive). Make Tabs controlled via useSearchParams (value={searchParams.get('tab')||'favorites'}, onValueChange sets param).

issues: 'Notifică toți utilizatorii' toggle defaults to ON - any save (e.g. fixing a typo in the URL) broadcasts to ALL users. Safer default is OFF.
Notification CTA button in NavBar lacks data-testid.

action_items: Fix Profile tabs to react to ?tab changes (controlled Tabs with useSearchParams)
GET /settings/desktop-app: don't fall back to default when stored size is empty string
Consider default notify=false in AdminDesktopApp and/or skip broadcast if version unchanged
Add data-testid to notification CTA button in NavBar.jsx

NOTE: Vision page setting is currently ENABLED (settings.vision_page enabled=true, updated_at 2026-11-05T15:09:16, predates this test run). Review request says it must stay OFF - I did NOT change it; main agent should verify/turn it off if intended. It blocks non-admin login (503).

server.py get_desktop_app `or` fallback masks intentionally empty values
